3 · Preview and generate

Side modules use an exterior-only side projection. For every Y/Z location the app keeps only the first/outermost X hit seen from that side, then fills inward to make a clean Boundary Fill solid. Hidden scan junk, underside cavities and internal geometry cannot imprint onto the module. Symmetry mirrors this clean projected surface first, then still uses the real target-side Pathfinder cutter and plug.
Model not processed yetPosition and rotate the mouse, then click Preprocess mouse. Rotation requires new side projections; the hump wall is reused. Scaling requires full preprocessing.
Left / right: first-hit exterior projection from ±X → watertight side envelope → target-side Pathfinder cutter → compact Boundary Fill cell → exact target-side plug.
Hump: reusable 0.9 mm outer wall → subtract supplied hump cutter → select rear region → clip the supplied rail to the uploaded outer mouse → join only the retained rail.
The colored preview shows the exact module regions used for export. Side modules are generated from clean exterior projection envelopes, so geometry hidden behind the visible side surface is deliberately ignored. In symmetric mode the chosen primary side is mirrored before the target-side cutter/plug is applied. The hump continues to use the actual selected outer mouse surface and the tutorial rail trim.
Pad height calibration

Default −0.60 mm assumes the supplied V2 foot underside at Z=0.20 mm with 0.80 mm skates. Match this plane to the bottom of your installed Pathfinder skates; it is a reference setting, not a measurement of your core.

Enter your skate dots’ dimensions. The foot stays at skate height; two vertical pillars connect directly to the underside of the Pathfinder rear rails. The foot stays centered on X. Move Y to place the pillars beneath the rails and the dots under the rear overhang. Gold = foot and pillars; green = rail connection; charcoal = purchased dots; blue = pad plane; red = printed plastic conflicting with the pad clearance or dots. Guides and dots are not exported.

Refresh the exact preview to build the rear skate support.

Side grip tape recesses

Full side outline with an inset measured in side view. The recess follows the curved exterior. The inset grows locally with smooth transitions where needed to preserve the chosen minimum backing and protect Pathfinder attachments. A notice explains adjustments; dashed charcoal shows the requested outline and gold shows the final cut. Gold lines mark the recess perimeter. Refresh the exact preview after edits.

The projection stage is intentionally a visual-hull/height-field operation, not a Boolean of the scan interior. Auto then evaluates the finite cells formed by that clean side envelope and the matching Pathfinder side cutter. The advanced selector is only for unusual cutter/model combinations.
